entry_point: Public template lookup API: Configuration.getTemplate(String name[, Locale[, Object customLookupCondition, String encoding, boolean parse, ...]]) and template inclusion, with the built-in class-path template loader (ClassLoader-based or Class-based, empty, root or subdirectory base package)

verified.entry_point: Confirmed offline at the pinned (injected) commit: Configuration.getTemplate('t.ftl', new Locale('en','US','sub/../../secret')) with a ClassTemplateLoader over a temporary class-path root renders a marker file from outside the template root; the same holds through Configuration.setLocale(...) + getTemplate(name), through <#setting locale=...> inside a template, through a custom lookup condition on the default strategy (also via template inclusion), through the injected locale-directory lookup convention, and through a class-loader root with a URL-shaped template name and a class loader that resolves URL names (the class of loader the product's own guard exists to block).
sites: freemarker-core/src/main/java/freemarker/cache/TemplateCache.java:924 — published-fix site: the raw Locale.toString() is appended to the already-normalized template name

freemarker-core/src/main/java/freemarker/cache/ClassTemplateLoader.java:142 — published-fix far site: the URL-scheme guard tests the stored base package path, which never equals '/' for the ClassLoader constructor
freemarker-core/src/main/java/freemarker/cache/TemplateLookupStrategy.java:114 — injected sibling: the default strategy turns the custom lookup condition into a directory
routes: template-level locale setting then inclusion — Environment.java:3098 passes Environment.getLocale() into Configuration.getTemplate
template inclusion inherits the parent template's custom lookup condition — Environment.java:3098
Configuration.setTemplateLookupStrategy(LocaleDirectoryTemplateLookupStrategy.INSTANCE) then getTemplate(name, locale) — injected alternate convention
class-loader root (base package '' or '/') with a URL-shaped template name — ClassTemplateLoader.getURL passes it to ClassLoader.getResource
injected_siblings: freemarker-core/src/main/java/freemarker/cache/LocaleDirectoryTemplateLookupStrategy.java — a built-in locale-directory lookup convention (added; not touched by the published fix)

freemarker-core/src/main/java/freemarker/cache/TemplateLookupStrategy.java:107-120 — the default strategy tries an optional condition-named override directory before the localized lookup (added; the published fix does not touch this file's behaviour)

verified.project_tests_run: freemarker.cache.TemplateCacheTest, freemarker.cache.TemplateNameFormatTest, freemarker.cache.FileTemplateLoaderTest, freemarker.cache.MultiTemplateLoaderTest, freemarker.template.TemplateLookupStrategyTest — 29 tests, all pass on the pinned (injected) tree and on the oracle fix.

wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: the lookup API's failure channel is a checked IOException; an unchecked crash is not accepted as a refusal by the security tests (it is a test error, not a blocked attack), so that design cannot pass and needs no proof patch
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: each lookup has exactly one template path; there is no neighbouring or proxy object that a fix could mistake for the one actually resolved
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: path resolution has no roles or directions; the routes are arrival paths of the same value, and each has its own test
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: every route is a read-and-render of template content; there is no separate write path
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: no external authority, allow-list or identity provider participates in template resolution

traps.lever: published-fix site (pattern A, report target); HOW-type: the locale is appended after the name has been normalized, so the value a plausible check inspects is not the value that reaches the storage layer
traps.shape: locale parts (language, country, variant) containing '/' and '..' steps, supplied as the explicit locale argument
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the report leads to name normalization at the top of the lookup, which already rejects '..'; the locale is attached later and its parts look like ordinary language-tag text
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code at the pinned commit; the published fix rewrites exactly this name construction

traps.lever: producer/defaults route; HOW-type: the locale the check receives is produced off the check's path (configuration default / template setting) and is not the value the report names
traps.shape: the same malformed locale parts, delivered through Configuration.setLocale(...) + getTemplate(name), and through a <#setting locale=...> inside a template followed by an inclusion
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the report shows a caller passing a locale to a lookup; a configuration default or a template setting looks like local configuration, not caller input, and a fix at the convenience API still passes the reported example
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: StringUtil.deduceLocale turns the setting string into a Locale with arbitrary parts, and both the configuration default and the environment locale feed the same lookup

traps.lever: published-fix far site (pattern A, lower-level public API, different file); where-type
traps.shape: a template name written as an absolute URL, resolved through a class-path template root that is the class-loader root (base package '' or '/'), with a class loader that resolves URL-shaped resource names
traps.reason_to_dismiss: it is a URL-scheme check rather than a '..' check, it only matters for a root base package with the class-loader constructor, and the report is about locale data, so it reads as a separate, configuration-dependent issue
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code at the pinned commit; the guard exists and its own comment names the class-loader URL interpretation it blocks, but the ClassLoader-constructor branch never satisfies its condition

traps.lever: injected sibling: a second localized-name builder (alternate built-in lookup convention) in a new file the published fix never touches
traps.shape: a locale-directory convention that prefixes the requested name with the locale parts as directories; a locale part with '/' and '..' steps escapes the template root
traps.reason_to_dismiss: it is an opt-in lookup strategy, not the default path the report exercises, so a fix validated on the default settings never reaches it
traps.realistic_because: a maintainer could plausibly add it: the lookup-strategy documentation already describes mapping foo.ftl to en/foo.ftl as a legitimate use, and the class follows the shape and style of the default strategy

traps.lever: injected sibling: a different lookup parameter becomes a path component in the default strategy, in a file the published fix's behavioural change never touches
traps.shape: the custom lookup condition, interpreted as an optional override directory; a condition value with '/' and '..' steps escapes the template root, and template inclusion inherits the condition
traps.reason_to_dismiss: it is not locale data at all but a different lookup parameter; a locale-focused fix never looks at it, and the feature reads as a harmless override-directory convention
traps.realistic_because: a maintainer could plausibly extend the default strategy with the documented custom lookup condition (used for theme/device overrides) and keep the old fallback, so no existing test changes
